scenarios.summary: An administrator grants a privileged role with no approval reference.

scenarios.summary: A privileged account signs in successfully without a second factor.

scenarios.label: benign

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: A privileged sign-in without a second factor that failed: no access was gained.

scenarios.summary: Six failed sign-ins to a privileged account within three minutes, then a success from the same address.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: Two failed sign-ins then a success: ordinary mistyping.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: Six failed sign-ins, then an approved credential reset by the helpdesk, then a success.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: Six failed sign-ins spread over nine hours, then a success.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: An account is disabled, and two days later signs in and reads confidential data.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: An account is disabled, re-enabled with approval, and then signs in.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: A disabled account attempts to sign in and is refused: the control worked.
